interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate with Sol-medium or Astra-light, delegate implementation to Luna-max, and review with a matching profile.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex a capability-routed delivery workflow: the primary session is verified as either GPT-5.6 Sol at medium reasoning or GPT-6 Astra at low reasoning, all implementation work uses one GPT-5.6 Luna lane at max reasoning, and the read-only reviewer uses the matching Sol-medium or Astra-low profile.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Route this implementation through the appropriate Sol Advisor lane.
Review this deliverable with the matching read-only reviewer before reporting done.
